title: Silica-supported isolated gallium sites as highly active, selective and stable propane dehydrogenation catalysts

propylene_rate.unit: mol C3H6 per mol Ga per h

records.location: Results and discussion catalytic-performance paragraph: flow (10 mL per min; WHSV, 2.1 per h) of 20% C3H8 in Ar at 550 °C; after 30 min selectivity 94.3%, TOF 20.4 mol C3H6 per mol Ga per h and conversion 9.3%; after 20 hours TOF 14.2 per h and conversion 6.5%; kd 0.02 per h. Fig. 4 caption confirms 550 °C and conversion range 9.3–6.5%. Ga loading from synthesis/elemental-analysis paragraph stating 1.53 weight% gallium loading for the grafted material used to make 3.

extraction_notes: Only the paper’s own non-oxidative PDH run for catalyst 3 is extracted. Literature/comparison values for Ga2O3, beta-Ga2O3, isolated Ga by electrostatic adsorption, and CrOx-Na/Al2O3 were not extracted because they are comparisons rather than runs measured in this paper. No reaction pressure or catalyst mass was reported in the provided article text. H2/C3H8 feed ratio is 0 because the stated feed was 20% C3H8 in Ar with no H2 co-feed.
